transcript: Gas line hookup for new clothes dryer at Walter White, 308 Negra Arroyo Lane. Teed off the existing one-inch black iron line in the laundry room with a one-inch to half-inch reducing tee. Installed a half-inch brass gas ball valve, fifteen feet of half-inch CSST flexible corrugated stainless tubing, and a four-foot appliance connector hose. Performed twenty-minute air pressure test at 15 PSI with manometer. Total labor three hours. Gas valve is twenty-eight dollars.

expected.job_summary: Gas dryer hookup with black iron tee, CSST tubing, and shutoff valve
expected.notes: Passed 20-minute 15 PSI air pressure test with manometer.
